description: Brand reveal hero with 4 concentric orbital rings drawing in, a cyan dot orbiting the highlighted ring, a gradient-clipped wordmark, and a row of tagline words staggering in. Use as the opening scene of an episode.
whenToUse: Opening scene of a video — episode intro / brand reveal
Cold-open replacement for hook-bigtext when the brand is the protagonist
When the script's first sentence introduces the brand by name

eyebrow.description: Small mono uppercase line above the wordmark. 2-6 words. Sets context.

wordmark.description: The brand name (or hero word) — rendered huge with paper→accent gradient. Keep under 14 characters for the gradient to read.

tagline_words.description: 3-7 short words that stagger in below the wordmark. Each word must be its own array entry — the stagger fires per item.
